text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through 
the Twinkle Series with my partner 
Umamusume would begin. The name of the 
girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Durandal, reporting for duty. ...Give me 
your orders, my Liege.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"I am your knight. With my 'Holy Sword', I 
shall surely deliver the crown of glory to 
you."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I shall cut down any formidable foe before 
your very eyes. Please, look forward to 
it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our challenge for the Twinkle 
Series with <chrname> began!
